stem:
Look at the diagram below.

Mom comes into Judy's room. → Judy says she has the mumps. → [empty box] → Mom takes Judy's temperature.

Which event belongs in the empty box?

options.label: A
options.text: Judy puts a cough drop in her mouth.

options.label: C
options.text: Judy makes a promise to Mom.

options.label: D
options.text: Mom tells Judy to get dressed for school.

visual_elements: Judy says she has the mumps.
